questions.title: 2025 CSSA, Fam_Q5, Programming the Web – HTTP request DFD
questions.stimulus:
An HTTP request follows these steps:

-   User types URL which sends an HTTP request through a web browser.
-   The web server receives the HTTP request.
-   The web server processes the request and retrieves the necessary website data from the web server storage.
-   The web server sends the website data and HTTP response back to the user's web browser.

parts.prompt: Draw a Level 1 Data Flow Diagram (DFD) to represent the process of how an HTTP request works.

marking_criteria.criterion: Provides a substantially correct data flow diagram that includes suitable external entities, processes and data stores, with suitable data flow indicated
Provides a relevant data flow diagram that addresses several of the requirements
Provides a diagram with some correctly labelled data flow diagram symbols
Provides a diagram that shows some understanding of the scenario

parts.marking_guidance: Sample Answer diagram will be professional re-drawn
